description: Hubble Money (operated by Gullak Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru) helps businesses launch in-app rewards and gift-card experiences fast: a modular, white-label B2B2C stack—catalogue of 500+ brand gift cards at discounted rates, no-code / low-code rewards store, SDK drop-in, and API paths for banks and corporates. Positioning: (1) B2B2C white-label infrastructure so the client’s brand and UX own the customer relationship; (2) an engagement and retention enabler embedded in the client’s product—not a standalone “engagement & retention platform” that replaces CRM or lifecycle stacks; (3) API and integration layer for voucher and gift-card issuance, redemption, and program operations, alongside optional UI modules. India-only focus. Public-facing site emphasizes launch in ~24 hours, internal currency integration, fraud prevention, analytics, and delivery via email, WhatsApp, and SMS.
sub_industry: B2B2C white-label gift-card & voucher API; engagement and retention enablement (India)
